articles.summary: Due to Tropical Storm Champi, Bank of Hawai‘i will temporarily close all branch operations on Guam and Saipan effective Saturday, Oct. 17 ChST, and will remain closed until further notice. This includes the bank’s Tamuning, Harmon, and Micronesia Mall branches on Guam, and its Gualo Rai Branch on Saipan.
articles.title: Bank of Hawai‘i to Temporarily Close Guam and Saipan Branches Due to Tropical Storm Champi
